verdict.rationale: Stripe's Invoicing workflow-transitions documentation describes webhooks as real-time JSON push notifications over HTTPS. It lists the webhooks emitted as invoices move through their lifecycle, so the core of event subscription is documented first-party. However, the pack shows only this single mention and nothing on how subscription itself is configured. Missing for 10: evidence on registering endpoints and selecting event types, signature verification, delivery and retry guarantees, local webhook testing tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
